local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")

local GameEnum = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("GameEnum"))
local GameHelper = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("Helpers"):WaitForChild("GameHelper"))
local ToolHelper = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("Helpers"):WaitForChild("ToolHelper"))

local LocalPlayer = game.Players.LocalPlayer
local connectedTools = {}
local characterConnections = {}
local activeProfiles = {}
local vibrationToken = 0
local lastPulseTime = 0

local PROFILES = {
    heavy = {
        pressSmall = 1,
        pressLarge = 0.55,
        pressDuration = 0.14,
    },
    light = {
        pressSmall = 0.45,
        pressLarge = 0.12,
        pressDuration = 0.08,
    },
    melee = {
        pressSmall = 0.58,
        pressLarge = 0.18,
        pressDuration = 0.09,
    },
    hold = {
        pressSmall = 0.3,
        pressLarge = 0.08,
        pressDuration = 0.06,
        holdSmall = 0.12,
        holdLarge = 0.03,
    },
}

local function getActiveInputType()
    local inputType = UserInputService:GetLastInputType()
    if string.match(inputType.Name, "Gamepad") then
        return inputType
    end
    if inputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        return inputType
    end
    if UserInputService.TouchEnabled then
        return Enum.UserInputType.Touch
    end
    return nil
end

local function isInputSupported(inputType)
    if not inputType then
        return false
    end
    local ok, supported = pcall(function()
        return HapticService:IsVibrationSupported(inputType)
    end)
    return ok and supported
end

local function setMotorSafe(inputType, motor, value)
    local ok, supported = pcall(function()
        return HapticService:IsMotorSupported(inputType, motor)
    end)
    if ok and supported then
        pcall(function()
            HapticService:SetMotor(inputType, motor, value)
        end)
        return true
    end
    return false
end

local function stopVibration(inputType)
    if not inputType or not isInputSupported(inputType) then
        return
    end
    setMotorSafe(inputType, Enum.VibrationMotor.Small, 0)
    setMotorSafe(inputType, Enum.VibrationMotor.Large, 0)
end

local function scheduleStop(inputType, token, duration)
    task.delay(duration, function()
        if token ~= vibrationToken then
            return
        end
        if activeProfiles[inputType] then
            return
        end
        stopVibration(inputType)
    end)
end

local function getToolProfile(tool)
    if tool:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.Gun) or tool:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.BarrelPistol4) then
        return PROFILES.heavy
    end
    if tool:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.Axe) or tool:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.MeleeWeapon) then
        return PROFILES.melee
    end
    if tool:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.Heal) or tool:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.Bell) then
        return PROFILES.light
    end
    return PROFILES.light
end

local function pulseTool(tool)
    local now = workspace.DistributedGameTime
    if now - lastPulseTime < 0.03 then
        return
    end
    lastPulseTime = now

    local inputType = getActiveInputType()
    if not isInputSupported(inputType) then
        return
    end

    local profile = getToolProfile(tool)
    vibrationToken += 1
    local token = vibrationToken

    setMotorSafe(inputType, Enum.VibrationMotor.Small, profile.pressSmall)
    setMotorSafe(inputType, Enum.VibrationMotor.Large, profile.pressLarge)

    if profile.holdSmall or profile.holdLarge then
        activeProfiles[inputType] = profile
        task.delay(profile.pressDuration, function()
            if token ~= vibrationToken then
                return
            end
            if activeProfiles[inputType] ~= profile then
                return
            end
            setMotorSafe(inputType, Enum.VibrationMotor.Small, profile.holdSmall or 0)
            setMotorSafe(inputType, Enum.VibrationMotor.Large, profile.holdLarge or 0)
        end)
        return
    end

    activeProfiles[inputType] = nil
    scheduleStop(inputType, token, profile.pressDuration)
end

local function releaseTool()
    local inputType = getActiveInputType()
    if not inputType then
        return
    end
    activeProfiles[inputType] = nil
    vibrationToken += 1
    stopVibration(inputType)
end

local function bindTool(tool)
    if connectedTools[tool] or not tool:IsA("Tool") then
        return
    end

    connectedTools[tool] = {
        activated = tool.Activated:Connect(function()
            pulseTool(tool)
        end),
        deactivated = tool.Deactivated:Connect(releaseTool),
        ancestryChanged = tool.AncestryChanged:Connect(function(_, parent)
            if not parent then
                releaseTool()
            end
        end),
    }
end

local function unbindTool(tool)
    local connections = connectedTools[tool]
    if connections then
        for _, connection in pairs(connections) do
            connection:Disconnect()
        end
        connectedTools[tool] = nil
    end
end

local function bindCharacter(character)
    for tool, _ in pairs(connectedTools) do
        unbindTool(tool)
    end
    for _, connection in ipairs(characterConnections) do
        connection:Disconnect()
    end
    table.clear(characterConnections)
    table.clear(activeProfiles)
    vibrationToken += 1

    for _, child in ipairs(character:GetChildren()) do
        bindTool(child)
    end

    table.insert(characterConnections, character.ChildAdded:Connect(bindTool))
    table.insert(characterConnections, character.ChildRemoved:Connect(function(child)
        unbindTool(child)
        releaseTool()
    end))
end

if LocalPlayer.Character then
    bindCharacter(LocalPlayer.Character)
end

GameHelper.onMyGunFire.Event:Connect(function()
    local tool = ToolHelper:GetToolsInHand(LocalPlayer)
    if tool then
        pulseTool(tool)
    end
end)

LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(bindCharacter)
LocalPlayer.CharacterRemoving:Connect(function(character)
    for _, connection in ipairs(characterConnections) do
        connection:Disconnect()
    end
    table.clear(characterConnections)
    for _, child in ipairs(character:GetChildren()) do
        unbindTool(child)
    end
    table.clear(activeProfiles)
    vibrationToken += 1
    stopVibration(getActiveInputType())
end)
"}]}
